recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Further FHIR-43364 edits would be redundant or editorial; handle future Resource-context refinements under their own Jira keys.
issue_request: FHIR-43364 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and requested documentation explaining that StructureDefinition.context.type=element historically means an extension can appear anywhere extensions are allowed, including resource roots, even though Resource is no longer modeled as an Element. The resolution chose documentation rather than changing tooling or inventing a new context expression, and also documented DomainResource/specific-resource root-only contexts plus fhirpath for all-elements-except-root cases.
initial_application: Upstream commit 2865d924342d7f3870bcbaefb89ecdd67b671a2a applied the issue by adding Notes to source/defining-extensions.html#context. Those notes cover resource/datatype roots, the legacy Element-anywhere convention, DomainResource/Patient root-only examples, and the fhirpath fallback.
additional_context: The December 2023 Zulip thread that preceded the tracker records the same confusion and confirms the grandfathered Element-anywhere interpretation. The FHIR-I 2024-04-08 minutes match the Jira disposition and vote. Later related work in FHIR-46620 refined Resource-context wording in the same area and is already represented on the combined branch, leaving current source consistent with FHIR-43364.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/defining-extensions.html:103-124 already satisfies the approved request, and StructureDefinition.context plus ExtensionContextType source points readers back to that Extension Context guidance.

related_jiras.note: Prior applied clarification of assigned-type behavior in the ExtensionContextType definition shaped nearby context wording but did not independently require another FHIR-43364 source edit.
Later Resource-context clarification touched the same section and already has Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-46620 on the combined branch.
